name: devdeploy
description: Raspberry Pi build orchestrator: dispatches build jobs to the right environment (local Pi, container, Mac/Xcode, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions macOS, Expo EAS) and manages artifacts and device deployment.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@devdeploy/core && npm run build --workspace=@devdeploy/providers && npm run build --workspace=@devdeploy/server && npm run build --workspace=@devdeploy/agent
